prerequisites: Disposable original EveJS deployment with authorized data
Two independently authenticated characters A and B in separate real corporations
A executor corp, B allied non-executor corp; one third unaffiliated character C
Preserved source deed, actual station manager/director roles and funded wallets

steps.action: A verifies executor corp CEO/director; B is valid allied director but not executor
assert: A can edit alliance
B cannot edit prime time, capital system, alliance policy or expel executive
B's genuine executor-support vote is accepted

steps.action: A holds actual Citadel deed in original inventory and deploys physically through original client
assert: Deed itemID and quantity consumed once
One native structure ID appears with A's corp owner, anchor timer, original solarSystemID
Crash before/after native creation-vs-deed debit fails closed without unpaid structure
All unauthorized writes denied
A's real CEO/director can manage own structure
No GM-only client RPC available to ordinary players

steps.action: A sets original structure profile to allow some alliances; B and outsider C attempt docking/services
assert: B gets only explicitly granted native access
C cannot dock or withdraw stored items
Client sees original service entry and denied errors

steps.action: A deposits actual fuel blocks, toggles service
assert: Native item quantities debited exactly at real tick
Service stops when original fuel truly depleted
Crash before/after fuel tick produces neither duplicate consumption nor free uptime

steps.action: A proposes legal transfer to B's corporation through supported native transfer flow
assert: Original owner authorization and recipient consent verified
Ownership and profile association persist after restart
Original assets and corp divisions retain correct property rights

steps.action: C launches actual damage while permitted; wait reinforced timer/vulnerability period
assert: Actual native HP, window and time dilation/real timer state
No client-only timer drift
After reconnect both clients see same state

steps.action: A declares supported paid war against an actual external corporation with valid owned HQ
assert: CONCORD bill and native war record one-to-one
Invalid or foreign HQ creates no bill
War spool-up and legal aggression consistent for A/B

steps.action: Destroy genuine War HQ through native combat
assert: War end state and billing updates once
Legally eligible station hangar items go to correct native asset-safety wrap
Wreck loot, destroyed rigs and asset-safety rights no duplication

steps.action: A anchors real TCU/Sov Hub and attempts sovereignty FLEX where system permits
assert: Claimable system and alliance identity verified
Real deed and fuel consumption
Sovereignty prime-time, occupancy and timers persist
B cannot change another executor's capital/prime time

steps.action: B corp leaves alliance, A loses executor privileges then reconnects
assert: Native alliance member index updated once
Old member cannot manage alliance assets
Existing structures retain actual owner corp and access is recalculated

restartPolicy: Cold restart original EveJS server and reconnect BOTH independent clients between all consecutive steps; compare native GameStore persisted IDs, wallet, bill, war, structure, alliance, sovereign, fuel and asset safety tables, not only client HUD
